model_output.extraction_notes: The qualifying public debt decomposition table is Table 1, 'Public Sector Debt Sustainability Analysis (DSA)―Baseline Scenario', on original physical PDF page 68. The decomposition block is headed 'Contribution to Changes in Public Debt' and includes rows such as 'Change in gross public sector debt', 'Identified debt-creating flows', 'Primary deficit', 'Automatic debt dynamics', 'Other identified debt-creating flows', and 'Residual, including asset changes'. The requested target year 2016 is present as a single-year column, but it is under the visible 'Projections' group heading, so the absolute actual/historical-only rule prevents extraction. Surrounding graphical panels and figures were not used.
